claim: Questions on ripping CD via Windows Media Player - Reddit
summary: If you're going to use Windows Media Player as your ripper, rip to WMA Lossless. For best results though, you shouldn't use Windows Media Player as your ripping software as you are unlikely to get an accurate (i.e. bit-exact) rip. Better options include Exact Audio Copy (EAC), CUERipper, foobar2000, and CDex. See Hydrogenaudio's Comparison of CD Rippers and list of CD rippers to help decide ...
